pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: AMS1117-3.3 assigns GND (GND) whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB assigns INPUT (VIN) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 2: AMS1117-3.3 assigns VOUT (VOUT) whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB assigns GND (GND) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: AMS1117-3.3 assigns VIN (VIN) whereas LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB assigns OUTPUT (VOUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.

parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: ESR-Sensitive · >=22 µF · See datasheet ESR curve
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT). Soldering LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB onto a AMS1117-3.3 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
CRITICAL SHORT-CIRCUIT HAZARD: Exposed thermal pad/tab net conflict (VOUT vs GND) — direct swap will short power rails.
CAUTION OUTPUT CAPACITANCE: Minimum Cout differs by 2.2x (AMS1117-3.3: 22 µF p.4 vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB: 10 µF p.13); account for MLCC DC-bias derating.
CAUTION ESR STABILITY WINDOW: Both parts are ESR-constrained, but AMS1117-3.3 omits explicit numeric ESR bounds (See datasheet ESR curve vs 0.01–3 Ω (p.13)); verify the datasheet ESR-vs-Iout curve.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AMS1117-3.3 is rated to only 15 V rec. (15 V abs max, p.2) vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB at 26 V rec. (26 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB supplies up to 400 mA (p.5) compared to AMS1117-3.3 at 1000 mA (p.1); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AMS1117-3.3: 1100 mV p.3 vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB: 500 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: AMS1117-3.3 has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (15 V, p.2) than LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB (26 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 15 V.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 54% higher on AMS1117-3.3 (AMS1117-3.3: 90 °C/W p.2 vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB: 58.3 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AMS1117-3.3 requires Vin,min >= 4.8 V (p.2) vs 4.3 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AMS1117-3.3: -40..125 °C Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ) vs LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB: -40..85 °C Industrial SOT-223 (-40°C to +85°C TJ for LM2937IMP DCY)); LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AMS1117-3.3 (Advanced Monolithic Systems, SOT-223-3) and LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (GND vs VIN), Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (VIN vs VOUT). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 22.9 °C on AMS1117-3.3 (θJA 90 °C/W) vs 14.9 °C on LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB (θJA 58.3 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 2.5x ratio (5000 µA (p.3) vs 2000 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AMS1117-3.3 "NOT Ceramic-Cap Stable — Requires 22 uF Solid Tantalum (No Numeric ESR Window Published)" (p.4) and LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB "CRITICAL Pinout & Tab Reversal vs. 1117 Family — Installing on 1117 Pads Shorts VOUT to GND" (p.3). BOM decision: Choose AMS1117-3.3 when load current exceeds 400 mA (up to 1000 mA); choose LM2937IMP-3.3/NOPB when battery sleep budget demands 2000 µA Iq or input rails climb above 15 V (rated to 26 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
